content: The New York Times Company is in talks”exclusive negotations” to acquire Letterboxd, the social network for film lovers, for around $330 million, The New York Times reports. The Times Company, Sony Pictures Entertainment, and A24 were all recently rumored to be among those interested in buying Letterboxd. The negotiations with the Times Company have included the potential for Letterboxd’s co-founders to stay in charge but report to a Times Company executive. Letterboxd would likely remain standalone for the “foreseeable future,” according to the NYT. The company would also integrate the Times Company’s ad tech. NYT spokesperson Charlie Stadtlander declined to comment. Letterboxd and current parent company Tiny Ltd. didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment from The Verge. If the NYT does acquire Letterboxd, it would follow other major purchases like Wordle (in a deal in “the low seven figures”), Wirecutter (“slightly more than $30 million”), and The Athletic ($550 million).

chineseContent: 据《纽约时报》报道，纽约时报公司正在就以约 3.3 亿美元收购电影爱好者社交网络 Letterboxd 进行“独家谈判”。最近有传言称，时代公司、索尼影视娱乐公司和 A24 都有兴趣收购 Letterboxd。与时代公司的谈判包括让 Letterboxd 的联合创始人继续负责，但向时代公司高管汇报的可能性。据《纽约时报》报道，Letterboxd 在“可预见的未来”可能会保持独立。该公司还将整合时代公司的广告技术。 《纽约时报》发言人查理·施塔特兰德拒绝置评。 Letterboxd 和当前母公司 Tiny Ltd. 没有立即回复 The Verge 的置评请求。如果《纽约时报》确实收购了 Letterboxd，那么它将跟随 Wordle（交易金额“低七位数”）、Wirecutter（“略高于 3000 万美元”）和 The Athletic（5.5 亿美元）等其他重大收购。
